About us

Marketing, learned by doing.

MarkInMind is the marketing society of Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, University of Delhi. We exist to help brands cut through the noise and connect with the student ecosystem — while giving students real industry exposure.

2024Founded under the convenorship of Ms. Saakshi Bhandari
Live briefsReal brands, real campuses, real deadlines
Idea → ImpactSpecialised teams own each part of the journey
CAMPUS ✦ STREET ✦ SOCIAL ✦ CAMPUS ✦ STREET ✦ SOCIAL

What brands get

Insight to on-ground.

Marketing isn’t about visibility — it’s about connection. We help brands build relevance, recall and trust in student communities through authentic, insight-led campaigns.

How we work

Four steps, one team.

InsightStrategy and consumer research on the student audience.
StoryContent and digital storytelling built for the feed.
